skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding and analyzing public investment activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp key concepts and objectives of public investment. Analyze principles and requirements for conducting public investment activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing management of public investment activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the management of public investment activities and coordination among government agencies during implementation.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing relationship between public investment and public debt
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the relationship between public investment and public debt.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding factors influencing investment decisions in enterprises
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze factors affecting investment decisions in enterprises.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding content of development investment in enterprises
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the content of development investment in enterprises and apply knowledge to analyze current investment activities in Vietnamese enterprises.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding management of investment activities in enterprises
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the management of investment activities and project management in enterprises.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying procedures for investment when implementing projects
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to implement investment procedures for projects.
Apply knowledge to analyze the investment environment at national and local levels and propose solutions to improve it.
Apply knowledge to analyze the promotion of investment nationwide and in localities.
Develop skills to adapt to changes, analyze and solve problems related to public investment and enterprise investment.
Develop systematic thinking skills such as strategic planning, investment decision-making, and selecting investment opportunities.
Have the ability to self-study, understand materials to complete assigned tasks and assignments.
Recognize professional ethics, be responsible to society and comply with laws.
Demonstrate a cooperative spirit and personal responsibility when participating in group work.
